Select distinct IC50 activities for compounds tested against Prostaglandin D2 receptor 2 (CHEMBL5071). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL5071, standard_type IC50, and presence of canonical_smiles. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
